top_violation_types.title: AP Never exceed capacity of the home (26 TAC §747.207(10))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation was observed caring for thirteen children. The capacity on the permit is 12.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation failed to submit a background check to CBCU for a caregiver present with children at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.303(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the evidence obtained during the investigation, a child was injured while in care and had to seek medical treatment. The operation failed to notify Child Care Regulation within the two-day timeframe of this occurring.

top_violation_types.title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: CPR training for the director was completed online.

top_violation_types.title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The caregiver did not practice fire drill monthly since 01/2022.

top_violation_types.title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - Splashing/Wading Activities (26 TAC §746.2101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection there was a total of 11 children with the youngest being two years old supervised by two caregivers utlizing a splash pad/ wading pool.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Infant was in a bouncer prop up with a bottle.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.
